info.name: AISHub Web Service Stations Vessel Positions API

params.name: username
params.description: AISHub member username (issued to qualifying feed contributors).

params.name: format
params.description: Value encoding: 0 = AIS encoding, 1 = human-readable. Default 0.

params.name: compress
params.description: Compression: 0 = none, 1 = ZIP, 2 = GZIP, 3 = BZIP2. Default 0.

params.name: latmin
params.description: Southern boundary of bounding box (decimal degrees). Default -90.

params.name: latmax
params.description: Northern boundary of bounding box (decimal degrees). Default 90.

params.name: lonmin
params.description: Western boundary of bounding box (decimal degrees). Default -180.

params.name: lonmax
params.description: Eastern boundary of bounding box (decimal degrees). Default 180.

params.name: interval
params.description: Maximum age of returned positions, in minutes.

items.docs: Returns the latest known position and voyage data for vessels tracked by the AISHub network, filterable by bounding box, MMSI, IMO, and maximum position age. Poll no more than once per minute.
